Already recorded by the mdf-hdf agent: Kronospan terms explicitly forbid copying and automated data collection. Note: on swisskrono.com 'Kronostar' is the SWISS KRONO Russia flooring brand (kollekcii-kronostar), not a chipboard decor range; Swiss Krono Russia ЛДСП is collected above.
Evosoft is a Kastamonu MDF panel with PET coating (not ЛДСП), and Kastamonu terms forbid copying without prior written permission (see mdf-hdf.json).
Out of scope: raw (unlaminated) particleboard and worktops, not ЛДСП decors.
